sections.Profile:
The "Starship Troopers" pinball machine, released by Sega Pinball in 1997, is based on the cult sci-fi movie of the same name. Designed by Joe Balcer and Joe Kaminkow, it features a fast-paced gameplay where players must free six bug-infested planets and capture the Brain Bug. The machine includes several multiball modes, a moving Warrior Bug, and a Brain Bug that pops up from beneath the playfield.
